6572327360.description:
Identify 11,179 bird species from a photo, with no internet connection.

BirdSnap runs entirely on your iPhone. No server, no account, no signal. Point your camera at a bird deep in a forest, out on a marsh, or halfway up a mountain trail, and get an answer in about a second.

WORKS WHERE THE BIRDS ARE
Cell service disappears exactly where birding gets good. BirdSnap doesn't care. Every identification happens on your device, so it works in airplane mode, deep inside a national park, or anywhere your signal gives out.

11,179 SPECIES WORLDWIDE
Powered by BioCLIP, a biological vision model trained on more than 200 million images of living organisms. Covers the world's birds, not just your region. A Northern Cardinal at the feeder, a Greater Flamingo on a salt lake.

INSTANT AND PRIVATE
Your photos never leave your phone. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is stored on a server, and there is no account to create.

FIVE MATCHES, NOT ONE GUESS
See the five most likely species, each with a confidence score, so you can judge a close call yourself. That is what you need when separating a Sharp-shinned Hawk from a Cooper's.

KNOWS WHEN IT IS NOT A BIRD
Point it at a leaf, a lamp post or your laptop and BirdSnap tells you there is no bird, instead of naming the closest species anyway. Two separate models have to agree before you get a result.

YOUR SIGHTING HISTORY
Every identification is saved with its photo and date, grouped by day, so you can look back on what you found across a season.

No ads. No account. No tracking. Built by one person.

6504294358.description:
Welcome to Baba's Piano, a magical instrument of learning and fun that's perfect for kids ages 2 and up! Join Baba, the adorable blue baby dinosaur, on a musical adventure that will delight and educate your little ones.

Four Modes, Endless Fun! 

1. Spelling Mode:
Let your child become a musical wordsmith! In Spelling Mode, kids can use the notes C, D, E, F, G, A, and B to spell out words like CAFE, CABBAGE, or FEED. When they successfully spell a word, a fun and colorful cartoon image is revealed, adding excitement and a sense of accomplishment to their learning journey. Simply tap on the current word to clear the letters from the screen.

2. Staff Mode:
Unleash your child’s inner maestro with Staff Mode! Here, kids can see a simplified piano treble clef staff As they play notes on the piano, the corresponding notes appear on the staff, helping them understand the basics of musical notation in an engaging and interactive way. While the staff doesn't contain a complete description like real sheet music, it's a great way to inspire a true beginner to learn more about musical notation and reading real sheet music in the future.

3. Song Mode
Want to learn some simple melodies on the piano from songs you've heard before? Baba Piano has some built-in songs that we all know and love. As the song plays, the notes will appear on the staff and the keys will highlight so you can learn to play these simple melodies too. 
  
   Songs:
   Happy Birthday
   5 Speckled Frogs
   The Itsy Bitsy Spider
   Mary Had a Little Lamb
   Shoo fly, don't bother me!
   Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
   Old MacDonald Had a Farm

   More songs will be added to the app via updates in the future and never for any additional cost!

4. Chord Mode

Chord mode allows you to play a major or minor triad chord with the tap of a single button. The notes of the chord are displayed on the staff and highlighted on the keyboard so you can learn which notes are being played. This is perfect for a little learner that wants to go deeper into understanding the piano, pitch and harmony, and chord structure.

Why Kids (and Parents!) Love Baba's Piano:

• Interactive Learning: Combines music and spelling for a unique educational experience.
• Simplicity: The interface is elegant and not bogged down with too many buttons or features. The melody lessons are simplified versions of songs meant for complete beginners, and the staff notation is a stripped-down simplified version of a real piano treble clef staff. It's meant to get your child interested in the piano and reading music without overwhelming them with all of the musical concepts and symbols at once.
• Safety: The piano operates 100% offline, making it a portable and safe app for your kids.
• Adorable Graphics: Baba, the cute baby dinosaur, makes learning fun and captivating.
• Engaging Rewards: Fun cartoon images keep kids motivated and excited to learn.
• User-Friendly Design: Simple and intuitive interface perfect for little fingers.

Let Baba's Piano turn learning into a joyful musical adventure. Download now and watch your child explore the world of music in the most delightful way possible!

1610864726.description:
GoFTP Server lets you seamlessly share files between your mobile device and your other devices. FTP is a standard network protocol supported by various applications available on almost any device with a network connection. With GoFTP Server, you can easily transfer photos, videos, documents, and any other files between your iPhone, iPad, Mac, PC, Windows, Linux, or any device with an FTP client. Enjoy fast file transfers over Wi-Fi, no cables required.

• Effortlessly move photos and videos from your iPhone to any Windows, Linux, or Mac computer - no cloud services needed.
• Connect to the app on your iPhone using the built-in FTP clients available on most operating systems - usually no additional software is required on your computer.
• Enjoy smooth two-way file transfers: send files from your iPhone to your computer or bring files back onto your device.
• Export photos and videos with your Photos albums preserved - albums become folders, keeping your media organized.
• Take advantage of the universal FTP standard to share files even with older computers and legacy devices.
• Transfer everything over Wi-Fi and enjoy complete freedom - no cables, no adapters, no hassle.
• Turn your iPhone into a mini wireless drive accessible from any device on your network.
• Share files privately within your own Wi-Fi network - with no third-party servers and no internet connection required.

Your cycle, logged deeply with details. Owned completely.

Petals is a private period tracker that keeps your data on your phone, ALWAYS. No internet needed. No account. No one can see your information, ever.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE.

Most period apps send your personal health information to their servers. Petals doesn't. Everything you log stays on your iPhone. There are no Petals servers. Your cycle is yours, and only YOURS.

SWITCH FROM ANY APP IN SECONDS.

Already tracking in Apple Health, Flo, or Clue? Bring your full menstrual history into Petals in one tap. You can import your period dates, flow, spotting and symptoms data directly from Apple Health and add it to your Petals timeline. No manual re-entry, no starting from scratch. Import once, or repeat anytime to pull in new data. Your Apple Health data stays exactly where it is. Petals just reads it.

TRACK 52 SIGNALS. UNDERSTAND YOUR BODY.

- Period & flow: mark period days, log how heavy your flow is, blood colour, clots and spotting

- Body signals: cramps, discharge, headaches, nausea, acne, brain fog, breast tenderness and more

- Lifestyle:  stress, sleep, travel, workouts, caffeine and more

- Vitals:  temperature, blood pressure, heart rate, weight and more

- Well-being:  mood, energy, cravings, focus, self-care and more

For each signal, you can add details like how bad it is, where it hurts, and what time it happened. Nothing gets missed.

REMINDERS THAT STAY QUIET.
Many period apps send cringy tips and weird messages you never asked for. Petals doesn’t. You choose what to be reminded about:

- Upcoming period: get a period reminder on the first expected day or a few days before
- Late period: a gentle nudge if your period is later than expected
- Signal logging: a reminder to log how you feel

Pick the time. Pick how often. Turn any reminder off anytime. Reminders are free and work offline.

WRITE YOUR OWN NOTIFICATION MESSAGE.
Don’t want family, friends, or coworkers to see “period reminder” on your screen?  Write your own, like “My parcel is on the way”. Your lock screen shows only your words. Only you will know what it means.

PREDICTIONS THAT LEARN FROM YOU
Petals predicts your next period using your own cycle history; not an average from someone else's data. You can also set your own cycle length manually if you prefer. Your body, your rules.

SIMPLE TO USE. NOT OVERWHELMING
Petals is designed to be simple, not overwhelming. Pick the signals you're feeling, add the details, and you're done in under a minute. Clean design, no clutter.

FIND ANY LOG IN SECONDS.
Every signal you've ever logged is saved in a searchable list. Tap any entry to see the full details.  Next time your doctor asks about your symptoms, everything is right there on your phone.

BACK UP WHEN YOU WANT.
Upgrade to Premium to turn on automatic iCloud backup - your data goes to your personal iCloud, not ours. You can also save a backup file yourself and keep it anywhere you like.

Premium includes: automatic iCloud backup and manual export.

Log everything and use all reminders for free, forever.

Download Petals today. Track your cycle privately, in detail, on your own terms.
